acceptanceCriteria: DecodeAttempt checks the profile first; a newer-profile attempt with an added key refuses UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, with a test.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

From the V1-0889 lane, 2026-10-06: DecodeAttempt checks closed keys before the profile, so an attempt written by a newer build that adds a key is MALFORMED rather than UNSUPPORTED_VERSION. Suspected defect for rollback across builds.

completion.reason: Delivered on origin/main 2b0cfce94; every acceptance criterion re-verified read-only in the pre-1.0 sweep. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-20-pre-1-0-sweep-delivered-closures.md (decision 0547).

title: corvint-tasks: DecodeAttempt reports MALFORMED instead of UNSUPPORTED_VERSION for a newer attempt profile with a new key
